Are you passionate about driving GCP compliance and quality excellence across global clinical development programs?

If so, now is your chance to join Ascendis Pharma as our new Associate Director, GCP Quality.

Ascendis Pharma is a global biopharmaceutical company committed to making a meaningful difference in patients' lives. Guided by our core values of Patients, Science, and Passion, we are applying our innovative TransCon® technology platform to fulfill our mission of developing new therapies that demonstrate best-in-class potential to address unmet medical needs.

At our headquarters in Hellerup, Denmark, research facilities in Heidelberg, Germany, and additional offices across Europe and the United States, we are advancing programs in our Endocrinology Rare Disease and Oncology portfolios. We also collaborate with partners on the development of TransCon-based products in other therapeutic areas and markets.

We are seeking a passionate Associate Director, GCP Quality to join our growing team. As a key member of the Ascendis Pharma team, you will play a crucial role in performing GCP audits. This is an exciting opportunity to work in a fast-paced environment, collaborate with cross-functional, global teams working together to achieve extraordinary results.

You will be joining the GCP Quality team consisting of 4 colleagues, and report directly to Lone Neergaard Pedersen, Senior Director & QP, Head of GCP Quality who is based in Hellerup_._ You will be based in Hellerup.

Your key responsibilities will be:

• Plan, perform, and report GCP audits (internal, clinical trial sites and service provider audits)

• Review and analyze audit, inspection, deviation and CAPA data to identify root cause, compliance trends and areas of exposure related to GCP

• Review and approve quality intakes, serious breach reporting, deviations and CAPAs

• Provide expert compliance and regulatory advice within GCP

• Author and maintain procedures owned by GCP Quality

• Support regulatory intelligence monitoring and assessing impact as well as implementation of new/updated GCP regulation

• Lead and support the planning, conduct and follow-up on regulatory inspections

• Collaborate with subject matter experts to formulate responses to GCP relevant inspection findings

• Drive quality development initiatives within the GCP area

• Perform expert consultation on complex aspects of GCP to projects teams and departments

• Perform the role of quality partner to assigned departments

Qualifications and Skills:

You hold a relevant academic degree - preferably a master's degree in life sciences - and at least 8 years of experience within GCP quality from the pharmaceutical industry. You are proficient in English at a professional level, both written and spoken.

Furthermore, you have:

• Demonstrated experience as a lead GCP auditor of clinical trial sites and service providers

• Strong working knowledge of drug development, clinical operations, regulatory authorities, and/or quality assurance

• Demonstrated proficiency in English at a professional level, both written and spoken

• Obtained a lead auditor certification

Key competencies:

You are a strong team player with excellent stakeholder management skills and a proactive, solution-oriented mindset. You thrive in a dynamic environment and can balance business needs with quality and compliance requirements.

You are highly structured, analytical, and able to simplify complex issues into clear recommendations and actions. You communicate confidently and effectively with stakeholders across a global organization and build strong relationships based on trust, integrity, and collaboration.

Travel: 30-50 days per year.

Office: Tuborg Boulevard 12, 2900 Hellerup, Denmark

Apply now.

We evaluate applications when received, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Please note that we conduct interviews on a rolling basis and reserve the right to remove the job posting at any time.

To ensure your application is reviewed, please submit it through the specified platform - applications sent by email or other channels will not be evaluated.

For more details about the position or the company, please contact Lone Neergaard Pedersen, Senior Director & QP, Head of GCP Quality, lnp@ascendispharma.com

You can learn more about Ascendis by visiting our website www.ascendispharma.com

Applications must be submitted in English and will be treated confidentially.

A note to recruiters:

We do not allow external search party solicitation.  Presentation of candidates without written permission from the Ascendis Pharma HR team (specifically from: Talent Acquisition Partner or Human Resources Director) is not allowed.  If this occurs, your ownership of these candidates will not be acknowledged.

**The Impact You'll Make

**As a Production Engineer at Danfoss Silkeborg in our plastic moulding department, you will play a key role in developing, maintaining, and improving our plastic injection moulding processes that produce plastic components for some of Danfoss' most iconic products - the radiator thermostats and its valve - made right here in Silkeborg.

You will be instrumental in ensuring that our plastic injection moulding processes remain capable, reliable, and ready to meet future customer demands.

You will work alongside a team of 11 skilled Production Engineers, where you will take part of the ownership of our plastic injection moulding processes and related production equipment. Working closely with operators, tool technicians, maintenance, quality, and product development teams, you will drive process optimization, troubleshoot complex production challenges, validate new products and materials, and implement robust solutions that ensure stable and efficient production.

This role offers the opportunity to combine hands-on engineering, problem-solving, and continuous improvement in a fast-paced manufacturing environment where new technologies, products, and materials are continuously introduced and your will have a direct impact on product quality, process capability, equipment uptime and productivity.

**What You’ll Be Doing

**You'll work closely with operators, tool technicians, maintenance specialists, quality engineers, and product development teams to improve process performance and support the introduction of new products, materials, and technologies.

**You Will

**

• Own and continuously improve plastic injection moulding processes, ensuring safe, stable, and efficient production performance

• Optimize moulding parameters, cycle times, material utilization, and process capability to increase productivity, capacity, and reduce waste

• Lead troubleshooting and root cause analysis of process deviations, quality issues, scrap, and equipment downtime, implementing sustainable solutions

• Introduce and validate new products, materials, tooling, and equipment, ensuring smooth implementation and integration into production

• Strengthen process and quality control through structured methods such as APQP, process validation, PFMEAs, control plans, and maintenance strategies

**What We're Looking For

**To succeed in this role, you'll combine technical expertise with a practical, hands-on approach to solving manufacturing challenges.

**Essential Qualifications

**

• Technical background within plastic processing, injection moulding, production engineering, mechanical engineering, toolmaking, polymer engineering, or a related field

• Strong understanding of injection moulding processes, tooling, polymer materials, and production optimization

• Ability to combine analytical thinking with practical problem-solving on the shop floor

• Strong collaboration and communication skills, with a proactive and solution-oriented mindset when working across functions and with external partners

• Fluency in Danish and English, both written and spoken

Experience with APQP, PFMEA, process validation, continuous improvement methodologies, or quality management systems will be considered an advantage.

**What You'll Get From Us

**At Danfoss, you'll join an experienced and collaborative engineering environment where you'll have the opportunity to influence products manufactured in high volumes and used in homes around the world.

You'll work with advanced injection moulding technologies and play a key role in introducing new products, materials, and manufacturing solutions, while being supported by knowledgeable colleagues who value teamwork, technical excellence, and continuous improvement.

We promote from within and support your learning with mentoring, training, and access to global opportunities.

You’ll have flexibility, autonomy, and support to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance. Your well-being matters to us.

We strive to create an inclusive work environment where people of all backgrounds are respected, and valued for who they are.

You’ll receive benefits like annual bonus, paid vacation, pension plans, personal insurance, and more. These vary by country and contract, but they’re worth asking about—we think they’re pretty great.

**Ready to Make a Difference?

**If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you!

Apply now to start the conversation and learn more about where your career can go with us.

For information about the recruitment process, please contact Talent Acquisition Partner, Gerd Veierskov, +45 3057 1882

**Our Commitment to Transparency

**Salary ranges listed reflect only primary location and currency. For local salary ranges and specific benefits in your preferred hiring location, please ask your Talent Acquisition representative for more information.

The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Any benefits listed do not promise or guarantee any particular benefit or specific action. They may depend on country or contract specifics and are subject to change at any time without prior notice.

Want to know more? Please visit our **FAQ Page.

jobs.occupation: Intern auditor til informationssikkerhed i Region Midtjylland - tidsbegrænset stilling
jobs.description:
Vil du være med til at styrke informationssikkerheden i en af Danmarks største offentlige organisationer?

I Region Midtjylland søger vi en intern auditor, der skal bidrage til at evaluere og videreudvikle regionens ledelsessystem for informationssikkerhed. Du får en central rolle i arbejdet med at sikre, at krav til informationssikkerhed efterleves, og at regionens politikker, procedurer og sikkerhedsforanstaltninger fungerer efter hensigten.

Som intern auditor skal du planlægge og gennemføre interne audits på tværs af organisationen og medvirke til at skabe overblik over styrker, risici og forbedringsmuligheder, som understøtter ledelsens beslutningsgrundlag. Du bliver samtidig en vigtig sparringspartner, der understøtter en kultur, hvor audit opleves som et redskab til læring, udvikling og løbende forbedring af informationssikkerheden.

 

Dine primære opgaver

Du får ansvar for at etablere og videreudvikle regionens proces for intern audit samt udarbejde og vedligeholde et risikobaseret auditprogram.

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være at:

• Udarbejde regionens auditprogram
• Planlægge og gennemføre interne audits i overensstemmelse med auditprogrammet og gældende krav til informationssikkerhed
• Fastlægge auditmål, auditkriterier og auditomfang
• Indsamle og vurdere dokumentation, interviewoplysninger, observationer og øvrige revisionsbeviser
• Vurdere efterlevelsen af ISO 27001 samt regionens politikker, retningslinjer og procedurer
• Identificere afvigelser, risici, forbedringsmuligheder og eksempler på god praksis
• Udarbejde rapporter og præsentere auditresultater for ledelse og relevante interessenter
• Bidrage til opfølgning på identificerede forbedringsområder
• Sikre, at eksisterende audits, tilsyn, it-revisioner og øvrige kontrolaktiviteter inddrages aktivt, så allerede tilgængelig viden udnyttes bedst muligt
 

Om dig

Vi søger en intern auditor, der er tillidsvækkende i dialogen med andre og formår at skabe gode og konstruktive samarbejdsrelationer på tværs af organisationen. Du møder medarbejdere og ledere med en anerkendende og respektfuld tilgang og udviser tålmodighed i auditprocessen. Samtidig har du modet til at identificere og påpege fejl, mangler og forbedringsmuligheder på en saglig og konstruktiv måde. Du ser intern audit som et redskab til læring og kvalitetsudvikling frem for kontrol.

Vi forestiller os derudover, at du:

• Er analytisk stærk og kan omsætte komplekse problemstillinger til klare konklusioner
• Har gode skriftlige og mundtlige formidlingsevner
• Arbejder struktureret og selvstændigt
• Evner at skabe samarbejde og tillid på tværs af forskellige fagområder
• Har kendskab til informationssikkerhed og ISO27001
 

Hvem er vi?

Du bliver ansat i informationssikkerhedsteamet i Digital Forvaltning, som er en del af Region Midtjyllands samlede informationssikkerhedsfunktion. Funktionen er et samarbejde mellem Sikkerhed og Compliance, som er en del af Digitalisering og It samt Juridisk Kontor og Digital Forvaltning, som er en del af Regionssekretariatet. 

Digital Forvaltning arbejder for at fremme digitalisering og sikre en systematisk, fælles ramme for informationssikkerhedsarbejdet i hele regionen. Vi er en del af Regionssekretariatet, der også varetager sekretariatsbetjening af regionsråd og direktion samt en række tværgående opgaver.

Arbejdssted: Regionshuset Viborg, Skottenborg 26, 8800 Viborg

 

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår 

Stillingen er tidsbegrænset frem til den 31. december 2028 med evt. mulighed for forlængelse.

Stillingen er som udgangspunkt en fuldtidsstilling.

Ansøgningsfrist den 5. december 2026. 

Ansættelsessamtaler forventes afholdt den 15. december 2026.  

Tiltrædelse: 1. februar 2027 eller efter aftale. 

Løn– og ansættelsesforhold i henhold til gældende overenskomst. 

 

Yderligere information om stillingen

Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen, kan du kontakte Rikke Stein, Kontorchef i Digital Forvaltning, på telefonnummer 21359030 eller på mail rikke.stein@rm.dk.

 

Stillingen er som udgangspunkt en fuldtidsstilling.

Da Region Midtjylland løbende gennemfører besparelser og omorganiseringer, vil medarbejdere i omplacering, der søger stillingen, have fortrinsret.

Region Midtjylland er jf. EU’s løngennemsigtighedsdirektiv, der trådte i kraft 7. juni 2026 forpligtet til at oplyse dig om startløn eller et interval for startløn for en stilling inden du tilbydes ansættelse.

Her finder du Region Midtjyllands lønkatalog for de fleste faggrupper og stillinger, som findes i Region Midtjylland: Gennemsigtighed forud for ansættelse - Medarbejder.rm.dk

**About The Role

**At FLS, we have simplified our business and strengthened our profitability in recent years. We are now shifting our focus to accelerating profitable growth. To steer this journey, we are establishing a Corporate Growth Office that leads our strategic growth and profitability initiatives in close cooperation with our Business Lines, Group Functions and other stakeholders.

As Director, Corporate Growth Office and Strategy, you will build and run the engine that turns our strategic ambitions into owned, tracked and delivered results. You will own the portfolio management, governance and operating rhythm of the Corporate Growth Office. This spans the monthly Growth Office reviews in our Executive Leadership Team and in each Business Line performance review. You will also connect the initiative portfolio to our corporate strategy process. As deputy to the Head of Corporate Growth Office, you will be a trusted sparring partner to Business Line Presidents, Finance and initiative owners.

Reporting to the Head of Corporate Growth Office, you will join a small, high-calibre team at our headquarters in Copenhagen. Around 80% of the role is dedicated to running the Corporate Growth Office and around 20% to corporate strategy work. The Growth Office enables, challenges and connects: our Business Lines own the delivery of their initiatives, and you will make sure it happens with pace, rigour and transparency.

**What You Gain

**This is a rare opportunity to build a Growth Office from the ground up at a pivotal moment for FLS, and to shape how a global industrial company steers its growth. You will gain:

• Close collaboration with our CEO, the Executive Leadership Team and Business Line Presidents and Business Line management teams.

• An enterprise-wide view of how FLS creates value across Business Lines, Group Functions, sales areas and our mergers and acquisitions (M&A) agenda.

• Visible impact, as your work shows directly in our results and in how we work together as one FLS.

• A broad platform for your professional development, combining growth office leadership with corporate strategy.

• The chance to help the mining industry move towards a more sustainable future.

**You will play a key role in

**_Setting up and running the Corporate Growth Office

_

• Designing and embedding the Growth Office operating model with the Head of Corporate Growth Office, including governance forums, roles and decision rights, the stage-gate process, value rules and reporting standards.

• Turning our corporate management model into a working operating rhythm, including the monthly Growth Office review in the Executive Leadership Team and the Growth Office segment of each monthly Business Line performance review.

• Building an in-house playbook and capability, so that FLS eventually runs its growth agenda with its own people, tools and routines.

_Managing the growth portfolio

_

• Owning one Group-wide view of growth workstreams and initiatives, with clear owners, milestones, value targets, risks and interdependencies.

• Running the stage-gate process from idea to realised value, including gate-readiness checks and rigour tests before key decisions.

• Keeping the pipeline healthy through quarterly re-prioritisation and backfilling of initiatives, and spotting off-track initiatives early.

_Executive governance and reporting

_

• Preparing decision-ready material for the Executive Leadership Team and Business Line leadership on value delivered against plan, value at risk, stage-gate decisions and blockers.

• Maintaining decision and action logs, driving follow-up and escalating issues that need executive attention.

• Contributing to Executive Leadership Team and Board updates and to the messages cascaded to the wider organisation.

• Deputising for the Head of Corporate Growth Office in executive forums.

_Value tracking with Finance

_

• Defining the baselines, impact categories and validation rules that make reported value credible, together with Group and Business Line Finance.

• Reconciling initiative value with forecasts, budgets and actual results every month.

• Rolling out and governing a common initiative-tracking software platform as the single source of truth.

_Partnering with Business Lines and Group Functions

_

• Acting as the Growth Office’s lead partner for selected Business Lines and Functions and challenging the ambition, pace and quality of their plans.

• Helping each Business Line establish its own Growth Office cadence in line with our common practice.

• Coordinating cross-Business Line and cross-functional initiatives, and supporting the integration of acquisitions into the growth portfolio.

_Corporate strategy

_

• Supporting the annual strategy process and preparing strategy material for the Executive Leadership Team and the Board.

• Translating strategic and financial targets into Business Line growth ambitions, key performance indicators (KPIs) and initiative portfolios.

• Leading selected strategic analyses, such as market and competitor insights, growth levers and business cases.

_Building capability and a performance culture

_

• Training initiative owners and Business Line Growth Office leads in our ways of working, methods and tools.

• Working with Communications and People & Culture on the growth narrative, success stories and recognition.

• Promoting transparency, accountability and fact-based decision-making across the organisation.

**To succeed in the role, you

**_Experience and education

_

• Have at least eight years of professional experience, including several years with a leading management consultancy, or equivalent.

• Have hands-on experience of setting up and running a transformation, growth or program management office end to end, ideally in a growth or commercial transformation and not only in a cost program.

• Have led or steered large, cross-functional initiative portfolios with direct exposure to CEOs, executive teams and boards.

• Bring experience of strategy work, such as translating strategic targets into initiatives and KPIs; experience of running a corporate strategy process or M&A integration is an advantage.

• Ideally bring experience from industrial, capital goods, mining, energy or other business-to-business companies with a strong service business.

• Hold a master’s degree in business, economics, engineering or a related field; an MBA is an advantage.

_Knowledge and skills

_

• Know the mechanics of a well-run growth office: stage gates, value tracking and validation, governance cadence, performance dialogues and tracking tools.

• Have strong financial acumen, including profit and loss logic, business cases, baselines and impact validation, and work naturally with Finance.

• Understand commercial growth levers such as pricing, sales effectiveness, aftermarket and service growth, and product and portfolio management.

• Create clear, concise and decision-ready material and storylines in PowerPoint and Excel; experience with strategic program management tools is an advantage.

• Are fluent in English; other languages are an advantage.

_Personal qualities

_

• Have the executive presence and credibility to challenge senior leaders constructively and to influence without formal authority.

• Are highly structured, rigorous and detail-oriented, while staying pragmatic and focused on what moves the needle.

• Stay resilient and composed under pressure and in ambiguity.

• Are collaborative and inclusive, with a coaching mindset and a ‘one FLS’ attitude.

• Act with integrity and discretion when handling sensitive information.

• Are based in, or willing to relocate to, Copenhagen, and are able to travel when needed.

• Have a genuine interest in FLS, our customers, the mining industry and our MissionZero ambition.

Total salary range incl. variable pay: DKK 1,220,000–1,800,000 per year.

• The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

jobs.occupation: Postdoc in tidal flat sediment dynamics
jobs.description:
We are looking for a highly motivated and ambitious postdoc researcher for a 20-months position commencing 1 February 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter.

  The Department of Geosciences and Natural Resource Management invites applicants for a postdoc position, dealing with the impact of sea-level rise and coastal squeeze on tidal flat evolution and sediment characteristics in coastal wetlands. The project is part of the research project ‘WadProof - Future-proofing the intertidal resource capital of the Danish Wadden Sea World Heritage Site’, funded by the Aage V. Jensen Charity Foundation.

  The research project

  The postdoc is part of the multidisciplinary ‘WadProof’ project focusing on advancing knowledge on the effects of sea-level rise and coastal squeeze on coastal wetland tidal flats sediment characteristics, the benthic fauna and the feeding opportunities for migratory birds in the Wadden Sea. The primary focus of the research will be to explore recent and historical changes in tidal flat development and texture, assess the effects of dikes and evaluate controlling drivers and forcing of tidal flat sediment characteristics and dynamics.

  The applicant will be collecting and analysing tidal flat surface sediment and core data, collect hydro- and sediment dynamic data and test remote sensing techniques using unmanned aerial vehicles (UAV) and orthophoto to map intertidal marine sediment type distributions. During the fellowship there will be periods with fieldwork in the Wadden Sea, laboratory and course work, teaching and dissemination.

  Who are we looking for?

  We are looking for candidates within the fields of physical geography, marine geology or other geosciences. Applicants should have a PhD degree and interest in estuarine and coastal geomorphology and good communication skills in spoken and written English. Experience with collection and analysis of empirical data, including processing of satellite and UAV data is considered an advantage.

  Our group and research - and what do we offer?

  The postdoctoral  researcher will be a member of the research group ‘Geomorphology, processes and landscapes’ in the Section for Geography. The research group studies processes that shape coastal, estuarine, marine, fluvial and glacial landscapes. We work at multiple temporal and spatial scales ranging from grains to landscapes and from seconds to millennial. The group uses quantitative methods with a strong focus on empirical data collection to map, analyse and understand the physical processes that shape the earth surface. Our group currently comprises two professors, two associate professors, postdocs and PhD students.

  The group is a part of Department of Geosciences and Natural Resource Management, Faculty of SCIENCE, University of Copenhagen. We are located in Copenhagen. In the project you will be collaborating with researchers from Aarhus University and from the coastal department of the Danish Environmental Agency

  The postdoc’s duties will include research as well as teaching. The post may also include performance of other duties.

  Further information on the Department is linked at https://ign.ku.dk/english/. Inquiries about the position can be made to Associate Professor Mikkel Fruergaard at email: mif@ign.ku.dk

  The position is open from 1 February 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

  The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

  Terms of employment

  The position is covered by the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff.

  Terms of appointment and payment accord to the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State.

  Negotiation for salary supplement is possible.

  You can read more about salary levels in the state sector www.loenoverblik.dk (in Danish).

  The application, in English, must be submitted electronically by clicking APPLY NOW below.

  Please include 

   	
• Cover letter, including the candidate’s motivation and a brief outline of suggested research contribution to the project (max 1,000 words). 	
• Curriculum Vitae, including a complete publication list, conference presentation list, and overview of teaching experience. 	
• Documentation: Diplomas for Master’s and PhD degrees. If the PhD is not yet awarded, please specify the expected date of submission and/or defence in the CV. 	
• Publications: Up to five selected articles (published or unpublished). The selected articles must be uploaded as attachments and marked with an asterisk (*) on the publication list.   The deadline for applications is 29 November 2026, 23:59 GMT +1.

  After the expiry of the deadline for applications, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the Interview Committee. 

  You can read about the recruitment process at http://employment.ku.dk/faculty/recruitment-process/.

  Interviews will be held during week 1 in 2027.

jobs.occupation: Laboratory Technician for Day Shift in an Environmental Laboratory
jobs.description:
Eurofins VBM Laboratoriet A/S is a leading provider of environmental and geotechnical analyses related to construction and civil engineering projects, delivering services within contaminated land investigations, indoor climate assessments, building screening, and more.

We manage the entire process of an investigation, from initial planning and sampling consultancy through laboratory analysis to the evaluation and interpretation of results. Our expertise enables us to support customers with reliable data and professional guidance throughout every stage of their projects.

We are looking for a dedicated Laboratory Technician to join our day shift team. Working hours will be agreed upon individually and scheduled within the timeframe of 06:00 to 18:00.

As a Laboratory Technician, you will be involved in the entire process, from receiving samples to delivering completed analytical results.

• You hold a relevant educational background as a Laboratory Technician or equivalent and possess solid professional competencies within laboratory work.

• You have an understanding of sample preparation, analytical methods, and data processing.

• You are able to work in accordance with established procedures, quality requirements, and safety standards.

• You work systematically and in a structured manner while maintaining an overview during busy periods.

• You have strong collaboration skills and a positive attitude.

• You can remain focused and organized when managing a high workload.

• You are fluent in Portuguese.

The position involves both standing and walking activities; therefore, physical mobility is important.

At Eurofins, your wellbeing at work is important to us.

We promote a healthy and supportive working environment and actively contribute to the physical and mental wellbeing of our employees through a range of initiatives.

As a Eurofins employee, you will be offered a pension scheme, health insurance, and access to independent advisors who can provide ongoing guidance and support.

Our canteen offers a varied selection of hot and cold meals, as well as fresh fruit and vegetables.

We value strong colleague relationships and organize a variety of social activities and events through our local staff association.

We operate on the principle of freedom with responsibility and therefore offer flexible working hours, opportunities for remote work, and employee involvement where the position allows.

Your Development

Your professional development is important to us. Together with your manager, you will have the opportunity to discuss Eurofins career paths, national and international talent programs, and other development opportunities.

#TestingForLife

Working Hours

37 hours per week, distributed across 5 working days.

Work Location

Industrivej 1, DK-9440 Aabybro, Denmark

Start Date

1 March

Interested?

Apply online by clicking "I'm Interested".

We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis and will hire as soon as we find the right candidate. Therefore, we encourage you to submit your CV and any relevant attachments as soon as possible. Under "Message to the Hiring Team", we would greatly appreciate a brief motivation for your application.

For more information about the position, please contact:

Christian Gamst, PBU Manager Christian.Gamst@etn.eurofins.com or Christoffer Røndbjerg Pedersen, Team Leader Christoffer.RondbjergPedersen@etn.eurofins.com

If you are selected as one of the candidates to move forward in the recruitment process, you will receive a link to complete a short video response to a few questions prior to a potential interview.

jobs.occupation: Global Business Owner, Global Supply Chain, ERP, QMS & PLM Transformation
jobs.description:
Ambu A/S is currently looking for a Global Business Owner, Global Supply Chain to be based in Ballerup, Denmark

In this role, you will lead Global Supply Chain through our global ERP transformation, making sure new processes, systems and ways of working are adopted and deliver real business value. You will report to the Global Operations Program Director and work closely with Global Process Owners, site leadership, IT, Finance, Quality and implementation partners across Denmark, Malaysia, China, the US and Mexico.

This is a unique opportunity to shape a major global transformation and see it through from design to lasting adoption. It will suit an experienced supply chain leader who enjoys bridging business and technology and driving change at scale.

**Key Responsibilities

**Your main responsibilities will include:

• Owning the transformation roadmap, target operating model and benefit case for Global Supply Chain

• Representing Global Supply Chain in program governance and making timely decisions

• Driving adoption, change management and deployment readiness across sites

• Ensuring processes, data and systems meet quality and regulatory requirements

**Suggested candidate profile

****Skills

**Skills and experiences can be earned in many different ways, and we understand that the best fit for the role cannot be prescribed on paper. You are however likely to succeed in this position if you:

• Have 10+ years of leadership experience within Global Supply Chain

• Have led large-scale business or ERP-enabled transformation initiatives

• Have experience working across global organizations and sites

• Come from manufacturing, medical devices, life sciences or another regulated industry

• Have built business cases and delivered measurable improvements

• Have strong executive presence and can influence across functions and sites

• Understand ERP-enabled processes and are flexible to travel internationally

**Ambu – a visionary and international workplace where your efforts matter

**Ambu is a company that expands rapidly and has ambitious growth targets. We meet these targets through interdisciplinary teamwork between motivated and highly skilled employees. Your contributions and efforts are crucial to our success and by joining us you will get the opportunity to work in an international head office with an informal working environment.

We offer great opportunities for personal development. Furthermore, we offer a wide range of professional, social and financial employee benefits in addition to exciting job challenges and continuous professional and personal development.
